n: const APP_VERSION="v18";(()=>{const run=()=>{const root=document.querySelector("#app")||document.body;const hs=[...root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,[role=heading]")].filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null);const sales=hs.some(e=>/laporan\s+penjualan/i.test(e.textContent||""));const pnl=hs.some(e=>/laporan\s+laba\s+rugi/i.test(e.textContent||""));if(!sales||pnl)return;const els=[...root.querySelectorAll("body *")];for(const e of els){if(e.offsetParent===null||e.children.length>3)continue;const t=(e.innerText||e.textContent||"").trim().replace(/\s+/g," ");if(!/\bomset\b/i.test(t)||t.length>100)continue;let p=e;for(let i=0;i<6&&p.parentElement;i++,p=p.parentElement){if(p.classList&&(p.classList.contains("card")||p.classList.contains("item")||p.classList.contains("stat")||p.classList.contains("metric")))break;}if(p&&p!==root){p.style.setProperty("display","none","important");p.setAttribute("data-hidden-omset-patch","v18");}}};new MutationObserver(run).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});run();})();
